text: Lunch with Siobhan. She's gone fully vegan since the summer and says oat milk is the only one that doesn't split in coffee.
Abdi's birthday is next Saturday. Remind me to order the cake on Wednesday and pick it up the morning of.
Fatima mentioned she's allergic to sesame, properly allergic, carries an EpiPen. Worth remembering before the dinner on Friday.

Milan is really into vinyl at the moment, mostly old jazz and Blue Note pressings he finds at car boot sales. He's been complaining that half of them crackle, and he keeps saying he wants a decent record cleaner but won't buy one himself. His birthday is the week after next, so that's the present sorted. He also likes those dark chocolate gingers from the deli.
Need to buy bin bags, descaler and a new phone charger this weekend.

Long call with Natasha tonight. Her mum has a hip operation next Tuesday and she's driving down to Cardiff the day before to stay with her. She's worried because her mum is diabetic and the last anaesthetic didn't go well. Her brother Gareth can't get time off, so it's all on her. I should text her that evening to see how it went, and maybe send something for her mum a few days afterwards.
Jack doesn't drink anymore, he's been sober for two years. Get some alcohol-free beer in for the barbecue.
Marcus and his wife Joanna are celebrating ten years married on the 14th. They're going to Lisbon for the long weekend.
Bogdan's dog Pickle had her teeth out yesterday. He said she's sulking but eating again.
Remind me to ask Chidi how his driving test went. It was this morning and he was really nervous about the roundabouts.
Carmen loves salted caramel anything. Also hates coriander with a passion, so no Thai green curry when she comes over.
The book club dinner on Thursday is cancelled because half of us have the flu. Joy is rescheduling for next month.
Lila's daughter is turning six in a fortnight. She's obsessed with dinosaurs and space, so a glow-in-the-dark star kit would be perfect.
Ibrahim is fasting for a few days next week, so don't suggest lunch. Maybe a coffee after sunset instead.
Spoke to Akira after the conference. He gave his talk on Monday and said it went better than expected. He's now applying for a team lead role.
I'm making the lamb tagine for Saturday and Gareth is bringing dessert. Mihai can't eat gluten, so I need to check the couscous swap.
Seo-yeon got her PhD results! Passed with minor corrections. Send her flowers this week and maybe organise drinks after her viva corrections are in.
Oliver has been struggling since the redundancy. He says he's applying everywhere but it's grim. I should check in with him on Friday.
Caitlin mentioned she'd love a pasta machine. Her birthday is 3 November.
Kate's brother Eli is getting married in the spring. She's doing a reading and is already panicking about it.
Zhang drinks his tea without milk but with a slice of lemon. Small thing, but he noticed I remembered last time.
Malik's flight to Karachi is on Sunday. Remind me to message him the night before to wish him a safe trip, and again the week after to see how his grandad is.
Dentist moved to Thursday at 4. Have to leave work early.
Juan and Carmen are hosting a housewarming next Saturday. He asked if anyone could bring ice. I'm bringing ice and a bottle of the Rioja he liked.
Demi said her partner Lola just started a new job at the council. She's finding the commute brutal.
Nasser is training for the Manchester half marathon in April. Carb-loading pasta every Friday, apparently.
Ali's mum is in hospital again. He sounded exhausted. Ring him tomorrow evening.
Note for future gift reference: Natasha collects tiny ceramic frogs. She has about forty now.
Mehmet is doing Dry January early, starting this Monday. Says he'll still come to the pub but will be on lime and soda.
Fatima's son Ali has his school play next Thursday. He's playing a shepherd. Don't forget to ask her afterwards how he got on.

Coffee with Siobhan and Abdi. Siobhan is moving to Glasgow at the end of the month for a new job, and Abdi is gutted. We should do a leaving dinner for her the weekend before she goes. Abdi says she loves dim sum, so maybe the place on Baker Street. I need to book it by Wednesday.
Jack's surprise 40th is off. His partner found out he'd hate it, so they're doing a quiet weekend in the Lakes instead.
Milan Petrov, the new neighbour at number 12, is a chef at the Italian on the high street. He said to pop in for a free tiramisu sometime.
Remind me to text Joy good luck the night before her audition. It's next Wednesday at the Royal Northern.
Marcus can't do dairy at all, it makes him really ill. Joanna says hard cheese is fine though, oddly.
Bogdan mentioned his dad's 70th is on Sunday and the whole family is going for a big Romanian lunch. He's in charge of the sarmale.
Gym, then groceries, then finish the tax return. Must do it before Friday.
Chidi said his sister Demi just had a baby girl last night! Both doing well. Buy a card and something small for the baby this weekend, and maybe drop round a meal a week after once they've settled.
Talked to Lila about her new allotment. She's growing chillies and wants to make her own hot sauce. A set of nice bottles and labels could be a good Christmas present.

Bumped into Ibrahim and his wife at the market on Saturday. They're expecting twins in March! He's thrilled and slightly terrified, and she's had awful morning sickness, can barely keep anything down except ginger biscuits and plain rice. They're also trying to move to a bigger flat before the babies arrive. Maybe I could help with packing the weekend they move.

Akira hates surprises, so absolutely no surprise party for his birthday on the 22nd. He'd much rather a quiet ramen dinner with a few of us, Seo-yeon, Zhang and me probably. He doesn't eat pork, so it has to be the place with the chicken paitan. I need to book a table for that Friday and remind everyone the day before.
Gareth's cat Bramble went missing on Tuesday. He's put posters up everywhere. Check with him tomorrow morning if she's turned up.
Mihai is vegetarian but eats fish. Prefers red wine, Pinot Noir especially.

Seo-yeon's parents are visiting from Busan next week for ten days, their first time in the UK. She wants recommendations for a good Korean restaurant that isn't too touristy, plus somewhere her dad can get a proper Sunday roast because he's seen them on TV. Her mum doesn't eat red meat. Send her the list tomorrow.

Oliver's interview with the bank is on Thursday afternoon. Remind me to send him a good luck message that morning and call him the day after to hear how it went. He said the last one knocked his confidence, so be encouraging.
Kate is off sugar for a month. Don't bring brownies on Saturday.
Caitlin MacDonald from the running club said her husband is a beekeeper. They sell honey at the Saturday market.
Natasha's anniversary dinner on Friday got called off because her husband is stuck in Frankfurt for work. She's disappointed but they'll do it next weekend.
Zhang mentioned he's been learning to make dumplings from his grandmother over video calls. He's proud of the pleats now.
Order more contact lenses tonight.

Eli loves anything to do with Formula 1. Big Ferrari fan, even though he complains about them constantly. Kate says he's been eyeing up a Lego Ferrari set for months but thinks it's too expensive to buy for himself. Could split it with Kate for his 30th in December. He also drinks an embarrassing amount of Irn-Bru.

Lunch with Malik went on longer than planned. His brother Ibrahim has his medical school interview a week on Monday, and their mum is apparently more nervous than he is. Malik wants to take him out for a curry the night before to keep him calm. I should send Ibrahim a quick message afterwards.
Juan's daughter Lila graduated from Leeds yesterday. He sent about thirty photos. I must send congratulations to them both.
Demi is gluten-free for real, coeliac, not a preference. Be careful about cross-contamination if I cook for her.
Ali mentioned he's starting a pottery course on Tuesday evenings. He's keen to make his own mugs.
Remind me to ask Mehmet how his mum's scan went last week. I completely forgot to follow up.
Joanna's birthday is on Thursday. She dropped a big hint about a new yoga mat, the thick cork one. Order it tomorrow so it arrives the day before.
Took the car in for its MOT. They'll call this afternoon.

Nasser and his girlfriend split up last weekend. He's putting on a brave face but I could tell he's not okay. I'll take him for a coffee on Sunday. He also said he's thinking of moving back to Bristol after Christmas, near his parents, which honestly might help. Don't push him on it though.

Spoke to Kate's mum briefly at the school gates. She's got her knee replacement on the 2nd and will be out of action for six weeks. Kate is going to cover the school runs and is already stretched thin. Offer to do Wednesdays for a bit, and remind me to drop round a lasagne the week after the operation.
